title: Named Conversion Event Ledgers
record_scope: Seventeen source-resolved events backfilled across the eight Phase 61 named conversion files, plus explicit bindings for every Phase 60 cycle item.
interpretation_boundary: Events record evidence movement at one named stage. They are not readiness scores, project forecasts, causal findings, or proof that a later stage occurred. Backfilled events are not receipts; future events require a dated editorial decision and receipt.

event_contract.date_rule: event_date is the exact official decision or publication date when the reviewed record supplies one; otherwise it is the explicit FTFN capture date and date_basis says so.
event_contract.backfill_rule: A backfilled event must resolve to a signal already assigned to the same Phase 61 file and to one or more source IDs carried by that signal.
event_contract.future_append_rule: A future event must point to a real dated receipt, preserve the underlying entity and stage, and satisfy the Phase 60 propagation contract before publication.
event_contract.immutability_rule: Published event identity, date basis, source identity, and prior-stage account are append-only; corrections use a new receipt and explicit correction event.
event_contract.cross_entity_rule: A receipt may append to a named file only when the cycle target and file share the same named entity or receiving-system stage. Adjacent sector evidence does not transfer.

events.date_basis: FTFN capture date for the official May 2026 agreement
events.title: Phoenix and TSMC wastewater agreement enters the named project trail
events.prior_stage: Regional and provider water context without a named project delivery instrument
events.current_stage: Project-specific wastewater conveyance agreement with later reclaimed-water milestones
events.evidence_artifact: City agreement authorizing bounded conveyance improvements and milestone conditions
events.interpretation_boundary: An agreement is not completed, accepted, or operating wastewater or reclaimed-water infrastructure.
events.next_gate: Accepted construction, operating flow, compliance, discharge, or facility water-balance record.

events.date_basis: FTFN capture date for the July 2026 City release

events.prior_stage: Physical campus buildout without one current facility-stage account
events.current_stage: Bounded production claim for Fab 1, construction completion for Fab 2, and structural progress for Fab 3
events.interpretation_boundary: One City statement does not establish accepted service, customer qualification, compatible repeated output, or a common campus stage.
events.next_gate: Facility-specific source corroboration, qualification, customer acceptance, and recurring production evidence.

events.prior_stage: Named application without a current citywide stage denominator
events.current_stage: Named application interpreted against separate citywide proposed, approved, permit, construction, and completion stages
events.interpretation_boundary: Citywide stock and flow measures do not establish this application's permit, start, completion, or occupancy.
events.next_gate: A matched project-stage artifact for application 24 254930.

events.date_basis: Close of the official July 29-30 Council decision window
events.title: Toronto City Council adopts item 2026.SC33.9
events.current_stage: City Council adoption without amendments with amendment bills withheld

events.interpretation_boundary: Council adoption is not amendment enactment, condition satisfaction, a permit, construction, completion, or occupancy.
events.next_gate: Introduced or enacted amendments, accepted conditions, or a confirmed permit, start, completion, or occupancy.

events.date_basis: Signal publication date tied to the regulatory decision

events.next_gate: Final route and land decision, construction, inspection, and energization.

events.title: Shuttle Landing Facility licence disposition remains unresolved

events.next_gate: Named system authorization and post-deployment assurance evidence.
